yale.t: Keck is limited-submission; Yale runs internal competitions through InfoReady (yale.infoready4.com, Organizer filter = Limited Submissions). Internal applications are generally due about 12 weeks before the sponsor deadline. Contact internal.proposals@yale.edu.
yale.unv: No Keck internal deadline for the Dec 2026 cycle appeared in the public Yale Funding Opportunities newsletters (Jan to Jun 2026; the archive stops at Jun 3, 2026). The InfoReady listing needs a Yale NetID login. Timing inferred from Yale's general 12-week rule, not a posted date.
